"""Read the prices CSV (DATA-01)."""

import csv
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from mdata.types import RawRow

COLUMNS = ("date", "ticker", "close")


def read_csv(path: str | Path) -> list[RawRow]:
    """Every row of a `date,ticker,close` CSV, in file order; a blank close is None."""
    with Path(path).open(newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        missing = [name for name in COLUMNS if name not in (reader.fieldnames or [])]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: missing column(s) {', '.join(missing)}")
        return [_row(record) for record in reader]


def _row(record: dict[str, str]) -> RawRow:
    """One CSV record as a RawRow; raises ValueError on a malformed date."""
    day = record["date"].strip()
    try:
        date.fromisoformat(day)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"malformed date {day!r}") from error
    if len(day) != len("yyyy-mm-dd"):
        raise ValueError(f"malformed date {day!r}")
    close = record["close"].strip()
    return RawRow(date=day, ticker=record["ticker"].strip(), close=float(close) if close else None)

"""Unit tests for mdata.io.read_csv (DATA-01)."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from mdata.io import read_csv
from mdata.types import RawRow


def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(text)
    return path


def test_rows_come_back_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(
        tmp_path,
        "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-03,BBB,20.5\n2024-01-02,AAA,10\n2024-01-02,BBB,19.25\n",
    )
    assert read_csv(path) == [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="BBB", close=20.5),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=10.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="BBB", close=19.25),
    ]


def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-02,AAA,\n2024-01-03,AAA,0\n")
    rows = read_csv(str(path))
    assert rows[0].close is None
    assert rows[1].close == 0.0


def test_column_order_does_not_matter(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "ticker,close,date\nAAA,1.5,2024-01-02\n")
    assert read_csv(path) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=1.5)]


def test_missing_column_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker\n2024-01-02,AAA\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="close"):
        read_csv(path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("day", ["2024/01/02", "20240102", "2024-13-01", "not-a-date"])
def test_malformed_date_raises(tmp_path: Path, day: str) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, f"date,ticker,close\n{day},AAA,1\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        read_csv(path)

"""Unit tests for mdata.io.read_csv (DATA-01)."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from mdata.io import read_csv
from mdata.types import RawRow


def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(text)
    return path


def test_rows_come_back_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(
        tmp_path,
        "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-03,BBB,20.5\n2024-01-02,AAA,10\n2024-01-02,BBB,19.25\n",
    )
    assert read_csv(path) == [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="BBB", close=20.5),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=10.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="BBB", close=19.25),
    ]


def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-02,AAA,\n2024-01-03,AAA,0\n")
    rows = read_csv(str(path))
    assert rows[0].close is None
    assert rows[1].close == 0.0


def test_column_order_does_not_matter(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "ticker,close,date\nAAA,1.5,2024-01-02\n")
    assert read_csv(path) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="AAA", close=1.5)]


def test_missing_column_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker\n2024-01-02,AAA\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="close"):
        read_csv(path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("day", ["2024/01/02", "20240102", "2024-13-01", "not-a-date"])
def test_malformed_date_raises(tmp_path: Path, day: str) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, f"date,ticker,close\n{day},AAA,1\n")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        read_csv(path)


def test_header_only_gives_no_rows(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert read_csv(_write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n")) == []
